title: clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. impensum
intro: Clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. impensum, commonly known as the Forest Glory Bower, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. impensum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against infections and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
